quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil to integrate and optimise Aruba's generating assets (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Order (release): Wärtsilä signed an agreement with Water- en Energiebedrijf Aruba (WEB Aruba), the island's energy provider, covering engineering, procurement and construction of a 35MW / 70MWh battery energy storage system plus a services agreement including a Wärtsilä energy management system (an 'As-a-Service' commercial model) and energy storage maintenance; booked in Q3 2026, with final taking over scheduled for Q2 2028. The release calls it Wärtsilä's largest energy storage project in the Caribbean region at the time of announcement; Wärtsilä earlier supplied WEB Aruba with engines and equipment for five power plant projects representing 230 MW.
quarterly_data.figure: 35MW / 70MWh BESS; booked Q3 2026; taking over Q2 2028
